title: ASIRT investigating prisoner's death in Edmonton police custody
article: The Alberta Serious Incident Response Team is investigating after a prisoner died Monday morning in police custody.
A police prisoner transport van left the police station just before noon with six prisoners who were being transported to the remand centre in the city's north end.
One prisoner was yelling and kicking while being placed in the transport van, ASIRT said in a statement.
While en route, the police officers driving the van noted the 46-year-old man who had caused the disturbance had quieted down.
The officers stopped the van to check on his condition and found him unresponsive and in medical distress.
Officers started CPR on the man while EMS was dispatched. The man was transported by ambulance to hospital, where he was pronounced dead.
ASIRT said the investigation is in its early stages and there will be no further comment until it has been completed.
